div.p: First-pass yield improved from 94.6% to 96.2% after the valve service. Downtime remains 7.4 hours, above the 6-hour limit. Sample 19 is outside the SPC centerline pattern but inside the product specification; treat this as a process signal for investigation, not a customer defect or capability claim.
